identity_separation.budget_authority_identity: original reservation_id (Backend-issued; unchanged; carried in task-continuation-reservation.v1)
identity_separation.recovery_submission_identity: recovery_attempt_key issued and atomically persisted by the Backend when it allocates an ordinal, binding (reservation_id, trigger_key, ordinal)
identity_separation.prompt_idempotency_key: recovery_attempt_key for a recovery submission (NOT the reservation_id, which the Adapter dedups to the lost old run)

interrupted_executor_epoch.source: the durable containment record (containment.record_loss wrote the failing epoch)
interrupted_executor_epoch.role: participates in the SOURCE loss trigger_key; must precisely match interrupted_run_id / interrupted_generation / containment_attempt

target_executor_epoch_and_generation.source: the Adapter reads the LIVE epoch at admission under record.lock and binds the new RuntimeGeneration
target_executor_epoch_and_generation.role: the Backend MUST NOT pretend to know the Adapter's live epoch; the Adapter returns target_executor_epoch/target_generation/run_id in the accepted receipt and the Backend persists them

trusted_carrier_extension.reason: the Backend does not know the Adapter's live epoch; the Adapter determines the target atomically at admission

recompute attempt_key' = 'recovery_' + sha256(trigger_key + ':' + str(ordinal))[:32] and require attempt_key' == attempt_key
require containment_attempt, interrupted_generation and interrupted_executor_epoch to match the durable containment record for the same session/trace/run
require prompt idempotency_key == attempt_key and the carrier reservation id == budget reservation_id
at admission under record.lock, read the LIVE epoch, create/bind the target RuntimeGeneration, and return {target_executor_epoch, target_generation, run_id} in the accepted receipt

per_attempt_receipt.prompt_receipt: journal.prompts[attempt_key] = {root_run_id, content_sha256}; distinct keys give independent receipts; old keys are never overwritten
per_attempt_receipt.guard_receipt: the new root's continuation-budget.jsonl read by read_guard carries the attempt charge

per_attempt_receipt.final_authoritative_aggregate: the Backend original continuation row's recovery_attempts, including target_executor_epoch/target_generation
per_attempt_receipt.cumulative_bound: exact charges of the original attempt plus every recovery attempt must never exceed R.token_limit

recovery_trigger.trigger_key: sha256('recovery-trigger.v1:' + reservation_id + ':' + interrupted_run_id + ':' + interrupted_generation + ':' + containment_attempt + ':' + interrupted_executor_epoch)
recovery_trigger.dedup_rule: under the task-row SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, scan recovery_attempts first; the SAME trigger_key returns the existing attempt; only a NEW authoritative fenced loss identity allocates the next ordinal
recovery_trigger.later_loss: a later recovery run that loses again yields a new fenced loss identity (new interrupted_run_id/generation/interrupted-epoch) and allows the next ordinal

authoritative_source.occurred_step_set: agent_domain_call_evidence rows for the same session, filtered to the exact (trace_id, root_run_id, generation, agent_run_id)
authoritative_source.snapshot_anchoring: when idle == true the Adapter issues a fixed {snapshot_tail_sequence, snapshot_digest} deterministically bound to (session_id, trace_id) and the ordered append-only call rows; pagination is fully anchored to it and every page is validated against it
authoritative_source.stable_snapshot_closure: the final page must have more == false AND idle == true; more == false alone under concurrent appends does not prove the tail is closed; any change to tail/digest/idle -> paused
authoritative_source.item_by_item_reconciliation: reconcile adapter pages with persisted agent_domain_call_evidence rows item-by-item by (session, sequence, action, idempotency_key, request_sha256, input_sha256); the union must be the session-global 1..N strictly contiguous
authoritative_source.atomic_check_and_start: submit_prompt, within the SAME record.lock (runtime.py:777-877) and BEFORE creating a new root/installing the target generation, atomically re-verifies the expected snapshot_tail_sequence/snapshot_digest is still identical AND idle == true; only then installs the target generation (closes the check-then-start TOCTOU)
authoritative_source.snapshot_identity_bound_where: the Backend classification/attempt aggregate and the carrier bind the snapshot identity
authoritative_source.same_snapshot_retry: retrying the same stable snapshot is allowed and does not allocate a new business ordinal (trigger_key dedup returns the existing attempt)
authoritative_source.closure_rule: obtain the fixed snapshot (more==false AND idle==true), reconcile item-by-item, verify session-global 1..N contiguous, THEN filter the target root by exact (session_id, trace_id, root_run_id, generation, agent_run_id); the target subset must be strictly increasing and consistent with the global sequence and does NOT need to start at 1
authoritative_source.per_call_binding: for every observed call, bind persisted (action, task_id, idempotency_key, request_sha256, input_sha256) and reconcile via agent_domain_call_claims keyed by (root_run_id, task_id, action, idempotency_key)
authoritative_source.step_safety: BYQ domain contract registry, never the client/prompt/display strings; a step is safe only when declared idempotent and result_verifiable and its exact receipt is settled

allowed: exact reuse of an original persisted safe call with the same (action, task_id, idempotency_key, request_sha256, input_sha256)
recovery_admission_envelope.enforcement: Backend admission verifies the envelope against the lost root's agent_domain_call_evidence and the closed registry
recovery_admission_envelope.new_key_authorization: never; enabling a new key is beyond this design and requires a separate Proposed ADR (not opened or implied by this slice)

budget_binding.real_concurrency_mechanism: task-row SELECT ... FOR UPDATE via _continuation_task plus in-transaction scan/dedup; no per-event_key unique constraint; no pg_advisory_xact_lock on this path

formula.step_1_grant_invariant: other_settled + other_unresolved + R.token_limit <= P.token_limit, else blocked
formula.step_2_r_headroom: R_available = R.token_limit - cum_exact, where cum_exact = exact charge of the original attempt (0 if never accepted) + sum of exact charged_tokens of every reconciled recovery attempt; None if any charge unknown
formula.step_3_no_double_deduction: do NOT deduct R.token_limit from P again; no new reservation; no new turn
formula.budget_available: TRI-STATE: blocked if permission revoked/expired/continuation_blocked_reason, or the grant invariant is violated, or ordinal >= RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX, or authoritative evidence conflicts, or R_available is KNOWN and < model_call_floor; None (paused) if R_available is None (any charge unknown) or any input unreadable or closure/step-safety cannot be authoritatively obtained; eligible otherwise
formula.read_only_floor_exemption: NONE - automatic rescheduling starts a new model run, so even a read-only-only envelope requires a known R_available >= model_call_floor
formula.controller_only_observation_below_floor: only a pure controller receipt/evidence reconciliation (no model call, no recovery attempt/run) may continue observing below the floor; it MUST NOT be called an eligible reschedule

tri_state_decision_table.condition: R_available KNOWN and < model_call_floor (any new recovery model run)
R_available is None (any attempt charge unknown) or any input unreadable
closure or step-safety cannot be authoritatively obtained

state_table.decision: eligible if grant invariant holds, ordinal < cap, and R_available >= model_call_floor
eligible if grant invariant holds, ordinal < cap, and R_available >= model_call_floor

safe_rescheduling.receipt_first: reconcile the exact prompt and guard receipts for the attempt key before deciding; success -> settled (never replay); conflict -> blocked; unresolved charge -> paused
safe_rescheduling.bounded: ordinal < RECOVERY_ATTEMPT_MAX=3 and R_available >= model_call_floor; cumulative exact charges never exceed R.token_limit
safe_rescheduling.trigger_keyed_exactly_once: same trigger_key returns the existing attempt; only a new fenced loss identity allocates the next ordinal
safe_rescheduling.attempt_ordinal_identity: recovery_<sha256(trigger_key + ':' + ordinal)[:32]>; audit/reconciliation identity, recomputable from trigger + ordinal
safe_rescheduling.auditable: loss evidence stays in the fenced adapter containment ledger; attempt charges/run ids/target epoch+generation stay on R; no second store and no /tmp authority
safe_rescheduling.fenced: stale interrupted epoch is expected (source); stale/duplicate TARGET epoch/generation, late settlement and terminal reopen fail closed (FencedWrite)

failure_semantics.ordinary_failed_cancelled_discarded_clos: keep ordinary semantics; interrupted projected only from fenced containment matching the same session/trace and exact run

adr_decision.rationale: only extends already-authorized components: the existing Backend authority row (in-row recovery_attempts keyed by trigger, no independent store); the existing closed contract/carrier plus a closed registry (no new persistence authority); the existing prompt/guard/settlement receipt surfaces keyed per attempt (no new store); the existing session-global call evidence and admission path (no new trust subject or cross-Plane interface); the existing Gateway->Backend /internal/task-continuation seam and adapter dispatch path; the ADR-0084 gate classification is unchanged. Allowing a recovery run to mint a new domain key is explicitly out of scope and would require a separate Proposed ADR
decision_points: recovery attempt persistence is an in-row addition keyed by trigger_key, not an independent store
the recovery_attempt_key is minted by the existing Backend authority; the target epoch/generation are determined by the existing Adapter at admission
per-attempt receipts reuse the existing prompt/guard/settlement surfaces
the recovery-mode envelope is enforced by the existing Backend admission using existing call evidence
no new trust subject, database migration, or gate-classification change
future_triggers_requiring_a_proposed_adr: a new public/internal cross-Plane authority interface
a database schema/migration such as a per-event_key unique index
allowing a recovery run to mint a new domain key (may_produce_new_key enforcement)
a change to the ADR-0084 gate classification
